headline: Advancing quantum control, thermodynamics, and sensing
summary: Today's crop spans diverse developments across quantum information science, ranging from novel thermal and entropy dynamics to architecture and sensing front ends. These works highlight sophisticated methods for manipulating complex quantum states and optimizing energy or information flow.

themes.title: Quantum Thermodynamics and Entropy
themes.body: Explorations of non-equilibrium quantum physics, including the demonstration of the quantum Mpemba effect via Stark localization and new quantitative entropy contraction bounds beyond detailed balance.

themes.title: Quantum Architecture and Photonics
themes.body: Architectural advances for scalable quantum systems, featuring a thermal microwave bus with high-fidelity bichromatic Raman gates for neutral atoms and loss-tolerant photonic GHZ state protocols.

themes.title: Optomechanics and Sensing
themes.body: Investigations into foundational optomechanical interactions explaining vacuum-mediated heat exchange, alongside novel Fisher-information training for optical sensing front ends using natural fluctuations.
